offres.intro: Three monthly levels of support, with no long-term commitment. Volume and channels can be adjusted at any time.
offres.tarifsIndicatifs: Indicative prices, to be confirmed — online payment via Tara from the client area.

confiance.titre: A local team with the rigour of an international provider

contact.metaDescription: Reach us on WhatsApp, by email or by phone. An answer within 24 working hours.
contact.titre: Let's talk about what is eating your time
contact.intro: WhatsApp is the fastest route — and it is where most of your own clients already are. For a priced proposal, the quote form takes under three minutes.

blog.intro: Sector-by-sector use cases drawn from real situations: what an assistant takes on, and what it changes day to day.

pageServices.metaDescription: Customer relations, appointment booking, debt collection, administrative tasks, community management and sales support — six areas, one point of contact.
pageServices.titre: Six areas, one point of contact
pageServices.intro: You are not juggling several providers. A lead assistant centralises your requests and brings in the team as needed.
pageServices.photoLegende: Two assistants at their desks, three-quarter view

etapes.texte: 45 minutes to understand your business, your channels and your friction points.
Written scope, proposed plan, signed non-disclosure agreement.
Access to your tools, drafting of standard replies, a first trial week.
Activity report and a monthly review to adjust the scope.

pageServices.ctaTitre: A need that is not on the list?

pageOffres.metaDescription: Three virtual assistance plans — Essential, Professional, Premium. Unused hours roll over, switch plans any time, 30 days' notice.
pageOffres.intro: Unused hours roll over to the following month. You can switch plans or stop with 30 days' notice.

faq.question: Can I switch plans along the way?
faq.reponse: Yes, at any time, effective the following month. No switching fee.

faq.question: What happens to hours I don't use?
faq.reponse: They roll over to the next month, up to 25% of your plan.

faq.question: How does payment work?
faq.reponse: Online from your client area via Tara, or by bank transfer against an invoice.

faq.question: Is my data protected?
faq.reponse: A non-disclosure agreement is signed before any engagement, and access is granted by name.

pageOffres.ctaTexte: We build a tailored plan around your actual volume.
pageOffres.indiceOrbite: Swipe or tap a plan to choose it

pageAPropos.metaDescription: Virtual assistance is a well-established profession internationally, and almost invisible in Cameroon. Nova Assist was created to fill that gap.
pageAPropos.titre: The profession existed elsewhere. It was missing here.
pageAPropos.intro: Virtual assistance is a well-established profession internationally, and almost invisible in Cameroon. Nova Assist was created to fill that gap, with the rigour of a firm and the flexibility of a small team.
pageAPropos.photoLegende: Portrait of the founder, plain background
pageAPropos.missionTexte: To let business owners focus on their trade, by taking on everything that doesn't move it forward.

valeurs.texte: What is said at our clients' stays with our clients.
Deadlines measured and communicated, not sales promises.
One named contact, reachable on WhatsApp just like your customers.
